items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: It was Al Dietz, I think, was the owner.

ctx.x: And the management claimed that they weren't making... even though they would... had standing room only, they weren't making out, but... I didn't care for the management, uh... they... I... It was Al Dietz, I think, was the owner. Was this, um... every night at Fainter? Six nights. All of Monday night. From, uh... 9 to 2.

Was it this feeling that the... do you think, with the management, that the band wasn't really as commercial as it might be? I mean, that seems strange to say they packed the place. They packed the place.
